evals.name: health-endpoint
evals.prompt: Add a /api/health endpoint to the Express server that returns JSON with uptime (in seconds), status ('ok'), and timestamp. The endpoint should be added to server/index.js. Also write a unit test for it in tests/unit/health-endpoint.test.js using vitest.
evals.expected_output: A working /api/health endpoint returning { uptime, status, timestamp } with a passing unit test

evals.name: toast-notification
evals.prompt: Add a toast notification component to the frontend. Create a showToast(message, type) function in public/app.js where type can be 'success', 'error', or 'info'. Style the toasts in public/style.css to appear in the top-right corner, auto-dismiss after 3 seconds, and have different colors for each type.
evals.expected_output: A showToast function in app.js and toast styles in style.css with success/error/info variants
